hero: Autologic Industries manufactures bike engine components for Bangladesh importers and workshops, using CNC machining and die casting in our IATF 16949 certified facility.

Engines in Bangladesh often run for hours in heat and humidity with little rest. Components made to accurate tolerances help those engines last longer between overhauls, and they fit without filing, shimming or other adjustments in the workshop.
We follow international standards for design, material selection and production, and our components are tested for challenging road and weather conditions.

faq_intro: Common questions from Bangladesh importers and workshops about our engine parts.
faqs: Which bikes do your engine components fit?
They are compatible with various motorcycle models. Share your model list, part numbers or a sample, and we will confirm fitment before you place an order.
Quality assurance checks are carried out at each stage of production in our IATF 16949 certified plant, and components are tested for demanding road and weather conditions.
Can you make components to our drawings?
Yes. Our casting and CNC lines can produce components from your drawings after a feasibility review. Samples are provided for approval before volume production.
Can I place bulk and customised orders together?
Yes. Our ordering system handles both bulk and customised orders, with clear pricing and planned delivery dates.
How are components shipped to Bangladesh?
By sea in protective export packing, usually to Chattogram, with the invoice, packing list and other documents your clearing agent needs.
Can engine components ship with clutch parts?
Yes. Engine components are often combined with clutch plates, hubs and housings in one consignment.
